sources.name: Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills
sources.description: External 754-skill cybersecurity library for AI agents, mapped across five security frameworks.

auth-bypass.focus: Broken authentication, authorization bypass, and privilege escalation checks.

data-leak.focus: Sensitive data exposure, configuration leakage, and exfiltration review.

idor.focus: Object-level authorization and tenant/user boundary testing.

injection.focus: Input validation, SQL injection, XSS, and command/data injection review.

mass-assignment.focus: Over-posting, unsafe model binding, and role/plan escalation review.

webhook-abuse.focus: Webhook trust-boundary, signature validation, and event forgery review.

cors.focus: Cross-origin policy, credentialed requests, and browser trust controls.

rate-limit.focus: Brute-force resistance, credential stuffing controls, and abuse throttling.

security-headers.focus: Browser hardening, secure headers, CSP, HSTS, and clickjacking controls.

url-enumeration.focus: Reconnaissance, exposed tooling, config paths, and source-control leakage.

user-enumeration.focus: Identity privacy leaks and account-discovery response differentials.

admin-enumeration.focus: Admin-surface discovery and privileged route reconnaissance.

admin-credential-stuffing.focus: Admin credential stuffing, weak default credentials, and lockout controls.

admin-data-exfil.focus: Privileged data extraction, PII exposure, and exfiltration evidence review.
